Mars Exploration · Project Presentation

MarsPath Pro

Exploring Mars is an extraordinary challenge that calls for careful planning, reliable information, and smart navigation. Our project, MarsPath Pro, focuses on supporting safer exploration of the Martian surface through an integrated navigation approach.

In this presentation, we invite you to discover our project, its key ideas, and how thoughtful route planning can help astronauts better understand the terrain and the challenges around them.
